role: bounded execution worker (breadth executor, not a group lead)
one_line: Author an insertion-only, clause/structure-scoped successor candidate for the class-separation guard and measure it against the standing pre-registered adoption bar on the frozen labeled corpora. Read-only on all canonical paths; no adoption; no gate verdict; no node status.
why_this_task: The audit lead's direction_update audit-l07-direction-separability-20260912T010517 states the measured impossibility result for lexical windows (PROSEFIX clears mentions but loses 10/12 HIGH genuine assertions) and directs the next attempt to a structure/topology cue (clause or dependency structure). No candidate with that design exists in the measured panel. The audit lead is the adjudicator and cannot author the fix (blocker audit-l07-b4); the PI card human-pi-detector-fix-20260912T0100 authorises the narrowest context-aware fix. This worker authors a candidate only, so the audit lead can review it independently.
design_hypothesis: Assertion-vs-mention in the CF-16 pattern is a scope phenomenon, not a lexical one: in every adversarial assertion a cue sits in a different clause than the clause carrying the merge predicate, while in every mention the merge predicate is itself negated, quoted, reported, rejected, interrogative, or governed by a mention noun. Therefore classify the clause that actually carries the merge predicate and the matrix clause that governs it, instead of matching cues in a flat character window.

architecture: L1 clause segmentation of the statement at sentence terminators and clause boundaries (; : . ? ! newline, and contrastive coordinators , but / , yet / , so), offsets preserved
L2 locate the clause containing the C0/C2 composite match; locate the merge predicate in that clause or in the sentence's assertive continuation

L3 quote-span detection: if the composite sits inside a quotation, the MATRIX predicate governs; the quoted material is demoted to mention unless the matrix predicate is an adoption/enactment predicate

L4 predicate frame classification: UNITY (asserts one class), SEPARATION (asserts split/distinctness), MENTION (says/quotes/reports/records/flags/rejects/denies/questions/tests), ADOPT (adopts/enacts/decides/requires/adopts-as-rule)

L5 scope resolution: negation scoped to the predicate; whether/that complements under mention nouns with negative or report matrix predicates; case-label and split-required frames; pronoun continuation clauses ('they are one class') evaluated on their own
precedence: 1. merge-prohibition frame in the evaluable clause -> MENTION (e.g. 'do not merge', 'never conflate', 'never write')
2. adoption/enactment predicate governing the clause or its quotation -> ASSERT (e.g. 'is hereby adopted as the rule', 'we adopt', 'the decision that', 'concluded that', 'we agree')
3. negated unity predicate in the clause -> MENTION (e.g. 'are not one class', 'no ... merge exists', 'was rejected')
4. interrogative clause or whether/that complement of a rejected/recorded mention noun -> MENTION
5. case-label / split-required / non-merge-compound / detector-self-quotation frame -> MENTION
6. unity predicate asserted with no negation or mention scope -> ASSERT
7. negated separation or split-prohibition followed by a bare composite -> ASSERT (negated split == assertion of unity)
8. otherwise UNCLEAR -> existing canonical decision path is retained unchanged (no behaviour removed)
non_goals: no new class-id, family, conclusion or whole-document rules are added; R2/R3/R4 and the declaration-mode fallback are byte-identical to the frozen pin
no canonical file is edited; the candidate is a new file under artifacts/worker-081/
no claim-retirement and no gate verdict is issued by this worker

adoption_bar_under_test.source: audit lead adoption bar (audit-l07-b3, reviews/CLASSSEP-calibration-adjudication.json) and worker-049 successor acceptance test

criteria.corpus_a_worker07: 27-fixture regression PASS, exactly tp17 fn0 fp0 tn10
criteria.corpus_b_labeled16: labeled assertion-vs-mention set (audit-authored, artifacts/audit/classsep_calibration.py) sensitivity >= 5/6 AND specificity >= 9/10
criteria.corpus_d_worker049_v1: 0 HIGH-confidence cue-induced FN (adversarial assertion clears while its cue-stripped twin flags)
criteria.secondary_w098_controls: 12/12 FIRE, 8/8 CLEAN silent, growth 0, 2/2 TP fire

adoption_bar_under_test.decision: A candidate that holds every criterion is adoptable-candidate evidence only. A candidate that fails any criterion is reported as a measured failure of the clause-structure hypothesis, not as a partial success.

in_sample_declaration: corpus_a, corpus_d v1/v2/v3, corpus_e, the 16-fixture labeled set and the w098 controls were all read by this worker before the candidate rules were frozen. They are IN-SAMPLE. A fresh held-out corpus (v4) will be authored by this worker AFTER the candidate module hash is frozen and will be evaluated once; v4 is the only out-of-sample generalization check and its result is reported whether it passes or fails.
falsifier: The candidate is FALSIFIED as a successor if any adoption-bar criterion fails on the pinned inputs, or if the held-out v4 corpus finds a HIGH-confidence cue-induced FN or a mention FP, or if the candidate cannot be reproduced byte-identically from the pinned inputs. A rule change after the v4 run voids the v4 out-of-sample claim.
non_claims: no gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status is set
no canonical, proposed, schema, ledger or claim file is edited
fluent text is not evidence; only the pinned artifacts and their recomputed sha256 are
